QuestInfo.name: [Maple Castle] Halloween Costumaniac
QuestInfo.0: Phantom is hanging out at the Maple Castle main hall. See what he knows about the artifact.
QuestInfo.1: Clear the Witch Cats out of the party room for Phantom and find the party outfit.
QuestInfo.2: You nabbed the party outfit and received the Maple Castle signature tablet.

0.0: Hey there, #b#e#h0##n#k! Fancy meeting you at a great party like this. No matter, what brings you here? \r\n#L0##bNeinheart wants to know about the Maple Castle artifact he gave you.#l\n#k
0.1: Oh, the #i3994658##b#t3994658##k?\r\nQuite a piece of work, this is. You can't really expect me to give something like this up once it comes to me.\r\nI expect a little something in exchange!

yes.0: I knew I could count you! Neinheart chooses his toadies well. Heh, never mind that. Let' talk business.
yes.1: I'm sure you've noticed that #bmy style is second to none#k. That is why the empress left the party costuming to me. I have everything I need... EXCEPT one thing.
yes.2: The #b#o9500587##k monsters carry around some magnificent costumes. Could you get the #b#i3994660##t3994660##k from them? 10 ought to do it. \nYou can find #b#o9500587##k at the #rHalloween castle party room#k next to me. I will divulge the secrets of #b#t3994658##k once the deed is done.

no.0: As you like. I have nothing to lose anyway.\n...But seriously, you're just going to leave me hanging?

1.0: You already beat all the b#o9500587##k monsters for the #i3994660##b#t3994660##k?

yes.0: Splendid! You took care of those unsightly #b#o9500587##k monsters. Thanks! Now, you want to know more about the #b#t3994658##k right?
yes.1:
This stone tablet contains the signatures of #bMaple Castle#k students from thousands of years ago. The writing is ancient, but you can still make the signatures out. There's a message, as well:

#b"We are destroying the magic scrolls and sealing up the castle to prevent the innocent and pure knowledge from falling into the hands of evil."#k
yes.2: What exactly were the students afraid of? Whatever it was, it was surely a #bhuge threat#k.
yes.3: Well, that's all I have for you. Here, the #b#t3994658##k is yours. Run along to Neinheart, and make sure he knows how I sacrificed to get him this information.

default.0: No party outfit, no #i3994658##b#t3994658##k. You know the deal.
